Demiurges wiki

An encyclopedia of Etherlords (2001) and Etherlords II (2003): every creature, sorcery, enchantment, artifact, hero skill and specialization of both games, with its statistics, description and picture, and what Etherlords II changed. It belongs to Demiurges, a fan-made engine that plays both games from your own copy.

Encyclopedia

SectionContents
CreaturesEvery creature by race: ether cost, power, toughness and abilities
Sorceries and enchantmentsEvery spell by race: type, rarity and ether cost
ArtifactsArtifacts, including those that summon a creature
Hero skillsSkills and the effect of each rank
SpecializationsChance-based talents of heroes

A card has one page for both games. Its table shows the two editions side by side: a highlighted value is one Etherlords II changed, and a card that only one game has says so. The lists mark each entry with the games that have it (I, II).

Open a creature's page in the game to rotate and zoom its 3D model. Choose an action below the model and press Play to preview attacks, hit reactions, and deaths with their original sounds when available. See About creatures for the controls.

Demiurges contains no game content. You need your own copy of the game you want to play. The GOG editions are the tested ones.
